command.exportClaude: Export VS Code servers for Claude Code
config.sources.claude: Offer the MCP servers from Claude Code (~/.claude.json, project .mcp.json).
config.sources.codex: Offer the MCP servers from Codex (config.toml).
config.copilotSync: What to do when a source changes and the Copilot config no longer matches: off, ask (notify), or auto (write managed entries).
config.blockedRemoteVars: Extra credential variable names that read as empty strings inside the url and headers of remote servers (the built-in list follows the Claude Code documentation).
config.language: Display language of MCP Unison messages: auto follows the editor, or choose en / ko.
